giveaways.form.title: Title
giveaways.form.prizeHint: What winners get, up to {max} characters. You deliver the prize yourself.
giveaways.form.keywordHint: Viewers can also enter by typing it in chat, for example !enter. Letters and digits only.
giveaways.form.durationHint: Up to {max} minutes. Leave empty to close entries yourself.

giveaways.form.error.title: Enter a title of up to 60 characters.
giveaways.form.error.prize: Describe the prize in up to 200 characters.
giveaways.form.error.keyword: Use 2 to 20 letters or digits, optionally starting with !.
giveaways.form.error.duration: Use a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440, or leave it empty.
giveaways.form.error.days: Use a whole number of days from 0 to 3650.
giveaways.form.error.watch: Use a whole number of seconds from 0 to 14400.

giveaways.verify.seedPending: The seed is revealed when the winners are drawn.

giveaways.verify.mineHint: Your own entry is marked. Only you can see which one is yours.
giveaways.verify.pending: The draw has not happened yet. Come back after the winners are drawn to check it.
giveaways.verify.cancelled: This giveaway was cancelled before a draw.
giveaways.verify.matchesHint: The seed matches the commitment, and re-running the draw here gives the same winners.
